title: Mozilla Teams Up with Mistral to Bring the Smart Window Feature of Firefox to the Global Market
excerpt: In the AI race in the browser field, Mozilla is taking a significant step forward. The pioneer of open-source browsers, Mozilla, has announced a deep collaborat
content_html:
In the AI race in the browser field, Mozilla is taking a significant step forward. The pioneer of open-source browsers, Mozilla, has announced a deep collaboration with the renowned French AI startup Mistral, officially integrating Mistral's advanced AI models into the Firefox browser, providing core computing power for the currently testing "Firefox Smart Window" feature.

This collaboration marks the official start of the expansion of this smart window feature internationally. Currently, the feature has been launched in the French market and supports French interactions. Support for English and German versions is expected to follow later this year. In addition, both parties plan to conduct specialized optimization and adaptation of the model to meet the localization needs of different countries and regions in the future.

At the core function level, the "Firefox Smart Window" aims to act as a comprehensive browser assistant for users, efficiently assisting them in handling complex browsing and information integration tasks across multiple tabs and sessions, completely breaking the isolated search state between traditional web pages.

Regarding the privacy and security issues that users are generally concerned about, Mozilla continues its long-standing principle of open source and prioritizing privacy. On the technical implementation side, the smart window defaults to not storing any user conversation history, and the partner Mistral has also made a strict commitment of zero data retention. This indicates that while Firefox fully embraces the wave of generative artificial intelligence, it still takes privacy protection, an open ecosystem, and local control as its unshakable core development directions.
